function.name: NtGdiGetSpoolMessage
function.description: This function is used to delay the execution of the spoolsv.exe process to avoid 100% CPU usage. It is a stub function.

parameters.name: ptr1
parameters.description: First pointer parameter, not used in the function.

parameters.name: data2
parameters.description: First DWORD parameter, not used in the function.

parameters.name: ptr3
parameters.description: Second pointer parameter, not used in the function.

parameters.name: data4
parameters.description: Second DWORD parameter, not used in the function.

function.name: NtGdiStartDoc
function.description: This function starts a print job for a document. It retrieves a pointer to a device context, traces the document details, and if the device context is valid, it retrieves a physical device and starts the document on that device.

parameters.name: doc
parameters.description: Pointer to a DOCINFOW structure that contains the details of the document.

parameters.name: banding
parameters.description: Pointer to a boolean value that indicates whether banding is used.

function.return_type: INT. Returns SP_ERROR if the device context is not valid, otherwise it returns the result of the pStartDoc function of the physical device.

function.name: NtGdiEndDoc
function.description: This function ends a print job for a specific device context.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: This is a handle to the device context.

function.return_type: INT, represents the status of the operation. Returns SP_ERROR if the operation fails, otherwise returns the result of the pEndDoc function call.

function.name: NtGdiStartPage
function.description: This function starts a new page for specific device context by getting the device context pointer, retrieving the physical device and calling the start page function of the physical device.
function.return_type: INT, represents the status of the operation. Returns SP_ERROR if the operation fails, otherwise returns the result of the pStartPage function of the physical device.

function.name: NtGdiEndPage
function.description: This function ends a page in a physical device context by retrieving the device context pointer, getting the physical device, calling the end page function of the physical device, and finally releasing the device context pointer.
function.return_type: INT, represents the status of the operation. Returns SP_ERROR if the operation fails.

function.name: NtGdiAbortDoc
function.description: This function aborts the current document in the specified device context.
function.return_type: INT, represents the status of the operation. Returns SP_ERROR if the operation fails.
